lemma: Seed accounting under Viola's Lemma 19 (as restated in PNP-001-LIT-6-2026-11-20.md): if M(x) = sum over alpha of P_alpha(x) with the P_alpha indicators of pairwise disjoint accepting computation classes (so M(x) in {0,1}), then fooling each P_alpha to additive error 1/(3|A|) with a Nisan-type generator for length-N ROBPs of width W gives total error <= 1/3 and seed O(log N * (log W + log|A|)). With |A| = (tq)^{O(sqrt t)} and log W = O(sqrt t * log(tq)), the seed is O~(sqrt t) * log q = N^{0.505+o(1)} at t = N^{1.01}.
gap: (a) Source-check: Viola's Lemma 19 must state that the P_alpha are disjoint indicators (unique-path decomposition). If they are only a signed or overlapping sum, per-piece error 1/(3|A|) no longer bounds the total error and the seed analysis fails. (b) The spec's exponent in Lemma 19 is garbled; the sqrt(t) reading must be confirmed against the source. (c) The target seed N^{mu'} with small mu' requires eps < 1/2 in t^eps; Viola's sqrt(t) gives exactly eps = 1/2, so the stated target is not met by this decomposition as it stands.

lemma: Barrier window (step 3, CLAIMED arithmetic only): if a local generator with seed s fools q-state time-t one-tape machines with oracle queries of length ell and answers absorbed into states, then q >= 2^ell and seed >= log q >= ell. With ell = N^{mu+o(1)} (CHMY Lemma 9), any admissible seed satisfies s >= N^{mu+o(1)}. The target 'seed <= N^{mu'}' is compatible with the barrier only for mu' >= mu.
